item.description:
## The Problem
Agent runtimes currently lack shared primitives for scope management, lifecycle events, and middleware across tool and LLM calls. Teams building or integrating coding agents must either piece together ad-hoc observability or accept opaque execution trails with no structured control surface. item.title: pr lens
item.description:
## The Problem Reviewing a pull request means reconstructing the system's architecture and data flow from a diff by hand. PR Lens removes that step: it draws the change as animated architecture and data-flow diagrams and posts them as a comment inside the PR, so a reviewer sees the blast radius before reading a line.

item.title: camera to blender
item.description:
## The Problem
Turning a physical object into a 3D model for Blender normally means photogrammetry software, multiple export/import steps, and manual cleanup. This repo collapses that to: take a phone photo, wait under a minute, and the model lands in an open Blender scene automatically.

`relay_server.py` is a FastAPI server (run via `uvicorn`) that serves the phone camera UI from `webapp/`, calls two external APIs to turn a photo into a mesh, and pushes that mesh to Blender...

item.title: Interface skills
item.description:
## The Problem
Building a polished interface — typography, color systems, accessibility, spacing — is knowledge that lives in designers' heads, not in codebases. When an AI coding agent works on UI, it produces output that is technically correct but visually mediocre, because the agent has no framework for what "good" means. This repo encodes that design judgment as machine-readable skill definitions so agents can apply it consistently.

item.title: OmniVoice
item.description:
## The Problem
Voice cloning TTS systems typically cover a handful of languages, and multilingual models often degrade in speaker similarity or require long reference audio. OmniVoice targets zero-shot voice cloning across 600+ languages with fast inference, so a single model can clone a voice and speak in languages the original speaker never used.
## What This Does

item.title: Open Source Face Recognition SDK
item.description:
